title: AI LABS BAYANG — Institutional Shadow Atlas of Major AI Model Labs
description: Comprehensive, evidence-bounded institutional audit examining public promises, legal control, capital/compute flows, model reflection, and displaced consequences across 10 major AI model providers.
scope: 10 major foundation model providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, xAI, Meta, Microsoft, Mistral AI, Cohere, DeepSeek, Alibaba Cloud)
exclusions: No psychoanalysis or moral profiling of individual founders
No claims that an owner's mind or shadow literally exists inside neural network weights
No unsourced allegations inferred solely from model tone
No speculative market valuation estimates where official numbers are absent

causality_ladder.level_4: Organizational decision and authority holder documented
causality_ladder.level_5: Independent causal evaluation or judicial/internal evidence

update_policy: Quarterly audit review or upon verified structural corporate re-organizations, leadership dismissals, or judicial rulings.
